question: The 1904 Tour de France winner wasn't crowned until four months after the race, when officials threw out riders over cheating. Where did 19-year-old champion Henri Cornet actually cross the finish?
question_short: The 1904 Tour winner was crowned months later after cheaters were tossed. Where did he finish?
answer_detail: Officials disqualified the top four, including defending champ Maurice Garin, amid cheating claims. Cornet inherited the win nearly three hours behind Garin and is still the youngest Tour winner.
answer_short: The top four were disqualified, so 19-year-old Henri Cornet inherited the win.
